jobs.title: Devops Engineer - SDE 2 (Bengaluru)
jobs.description:
Our journey so far

Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pays founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. Thats how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea: to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money. 

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter - and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.8 million+ happy users on Jupiter.

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where youve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for its head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.

We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. Were now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a highly skilled SDE 2 DevOps engineer, focusing on AWS infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-based architectures. 

Roles & Responsibilities

 Design, build, and maintain highly scalable and secure AWS infrastructure.

 Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and monitoring using IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

 Optimize CI/CD pipelines for productive and reliable deployments.

 Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.

 Ensure security best practices for cloud environments including IAM, VPC configurations, and network security.

 Troubleshoot production issues and implement solutions to improve reliability and performance.

 Collaborate with engineering teams to improve DevOps culture and drive operational excellence.

What is needed for this role

3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering.

 Strong expertise in AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, etc.

 Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.

 Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar.

 Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration.

 Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.).

 Scripting and automation experience with Python, Bash, or Go.

 Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments.

 Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for automation and scalability.

Nice to Have

 Experience in a fintech/startup environment. 

 Knowledge of database management and caching solutions.

 Exposure to multi-cloud environments (GCP, Azure).

Why you should work with us

 We like people who behave like owners and see projects through to completion.

 We take pleasure in tackling meaningful problems and crafting delightful customer experiences.

 We appreciate healthy conflict, ownership and commitment  we value consent over consensus.

 We constantly raise the bar. If you crave continuous learning and growth, Jupiter is the right place. .

jobs.title: Senior Cloud and DevOps Engineer-Azure
jobs.description:
Job Description

Cloud / DevOps Engineer would lead the implementation, automation, and operational reliability of cloud-native and DevOps solutions across Azure environments, with awareness of equivalent AWS patterns where required. The role would involve transformation of MVP applications into production-grade, multi-tenant SaaS platforms by enabling cloud-native deployment architecture—driving database migration support, containerized deployments on Azure, secure identity and access management, CI/CD pipeline implementation, observability setup, environment consistency, and performance optimization for scalable operations.

Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Implementation

 Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-optimized cloud solutions primarily on Azure.  Drive adoption of PaaS, managed services, and container-based deployment models.  Enable deployment architecture using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Entra ID / AAD.  Establish cloud governance, environment consistency, access control, and cost optimization practices.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

 Design and implement container-based application deployment using Docker.  Build and optimize Docker Compose setups for multi-service environments and multi-stage builds for secure, lightweight images.  Support deployment using orchestration services such as Kubernetes (AKS / EKS awareness) or Azure Container Apps.  Improve platform consistency, portability, and deployment repeatability.

CI/CD & DevOps Transformation

 Architect and implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps.  Enable automated builds, testing, and deployment with multi-stage environment promotion.  Support deployment strategies such as blue-green, canary, or rolling updates.  Improve release reliability, deployment speed, and operational maturity.

Reliability, Observability & Operations

 Implement observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and APM tooling.  Enable health checks, readiness validation, alerting, incident response readiness, and SLO-based monitoring.  Support resilience mechanisms including retries, graceful degradation, and fault-aware deployment patterns.

Security & DevSecOps

 Implement secure DevOps practices including secret management, identity and role-based access controls, and pipeline-integrated security scans.  Ensure secure configuration and alignment with enterprise standards for cloud delivery and operations.

Performance & Scalability

 Support performance strategies including caching, autoscaling, deployment tuning, and environment optimization.  Assist with provisioning and managing Redis / distributed cache services where applicable.  Enable scalable deployment patterns for growing user demand and system load.  Required Technical Skills  Docker / Containers | Advanced — Compose, multi-stage builds, image hardening, container deployment  Azure Cloud | Proficient — App Service, Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID / AAD  CI/CD | Advanced — GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps; automated testing and staged deployments  Git | Advanced — branching strategies, PR workflows, repository governance  Cluster Provisioning & Management | Proficient — Kubernetes / AKS / container orchestration awareness  Monitoring & Operations | Proficient — Azure Monitor, App Insights, dashboards, alerts, logs  Security & Automation | Proficient — secrets, identity, access control, scanning, IaC awareness

Required Experience

 Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Cloud / DevOps engineering.  Proven experience in enabling cloud-native deployment practices for enterprise or SaaS applications.  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and environment promotion strategies.  Experience supporting containerized deployments and modern cloud-hosted applications.  Experience with observability, operational monitoring, and incident-supporting platform practices.  Exposure to secure DevOps practices, secrets management, and identity-based access controls.  Experience improving deployment reliability, automation, and operational consistency across environments.

Preferred (Not Required)

 Exposure to MVP-to-production modernization programs.  Experience with Terraform / Bicep / infrastructure-as-code tooling.  Exposure to SaaS multi-tenancy, API gateways, or cloud platform hardening.  Experience in consultancy, infrastructure, or engineering sector platforms.  Exposure to AI-assisted engineering productivity tooling.

Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.  8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform operations.
